win_probability_and_next_best_action_bug.trigger: Owner asked for the full rule behind the Win Probability badge (led to discovering the bug, documented in d234ba4), then explicitly asked to explain again and attempt an actual fix.
win_probability_and_next_best_action_bug.bug_was: Neither win_probability() nor next_best_action() in ai_utils.py could ever produce a differentiated result. win_probability()'s stage_weights keys were PDF-style names that don't match our actual sales_stage field values; its stakeholder bonus checked influence_level instead of the real field role_in_decision. next_best_action() read doc.stage (doesn't exist) instead of doc.sales_stage, and compared against PDF-style stage strings. _days_since_activity was referenced in both but never computed anywhere, permanently disabling 4 of next_best_action()'s 5 branches.
win_probability_and_next_best_action_bug.fix_applied_2026-07-31_commit_be8271f: ai_utils.py: _STAGE_WEIGHTS now keyed on our real Sales Stage master values (Prospecting 5 ... Closed Won 100), stakeholder check now reads role_in_decision, added a status=='Lost' -> 0 override. next_best_action() now reads sales_stage and compares against real stage names. opportunity_hooks.py: added _days_since_last_activity(doc), a real SQL query over tabCommunication + tabComment (falls back to days since creation), wired into on_opportunity_update() so _days_since_activity is genuinely populated on every save.
win_probability_and_next_best_action_bug.still_intentionally_inert: scale_sales_budget_confirmed (+10 bonus in win_probability()) has no backing field anywhere in the Opportunity schema — Budget lives on Lead, not Opportunity. Left inert rather than inventing a new field without sign-off; called out explicitly in the popup's amber 'Still not wired' box.
win_probability_and_next_best_action_bug.verified_live: bench console: re-saved all 5 seeded Opportunities post-fix. Probability moved from a flat 20.00 (identical for every deal, pre-fix) to correctly varied 83/65/35/25/15, matching each deal's actual Sales Stage + stakeholder makeup (CRM-OPP-2026-00001: Negotiation/Review base 75 + 8 for CFO Decision Maker = 83). Both demo_ui.js popups (AI Win Probability, AI Next Best Action) re-verified rendering correctly in-browser on CRM-OPP-2026-00001's Contacts tab, showing the corrected rule text plus a green 'Bug found and fixed' callout with the concrete before/after numbers.

territory_auto_assignment.bug_found: frappe.safe_eval() runs assign_condition with the document's own fields as bare local variables (eval_locals=doc.as_dict()), not nested under a 'doc' name. First attempt used 'doc.territory in [...]' and silently failed with zero assignments and no visible error. Fixed to 'territory in [...]'. Verified via reading assignment_rule.py source, not guessed.

collection_management_audit_2026-08-01.stale_data_found_and_fixed: SINV-26-00001 was created/submitted 2026-07-27, before collection_hooks.py existed — its on_submit hook never fired, so scale_sales_collection_status/scale_sales_promise_to_pay_date sat permanently null despite the invoice being submitted. Backfilled by manually re-running on_invoice_submit() (not fabricated — this is exactly what the hook is supposed to auto-set), then set Collection Status to 'Promised' + a real Promise-to-Pay Date (+7 days) for a fuller demo view.
collection_management_audit_2026-08-01.navigation_bug_found_and_fixed: Owner correctly couldn't find the fields on the invoice — they render on the 'More Info' tab inside the collapsed 'Additional Info' section, NOT the Details tab as the old flow-path implied. Slide's flow-path and links corrected to point at the exact record + tab + section; the generic /app/sales-invoice list link replaced with a direct link to SINV-26-00001.
